about_the_game:
Dinos Falling is a cooperative 3D platformer for 1–3 players (local or online). Take control of clumsy dinosaurs trying to escape a modern city packed with traps, surprises, and hilarious deaths.

The rule is simple: “Reach the exit and survive.” But every level is full of tricks, unexpected obstacles, and situations where nothing goes as planned. Chaos and laughter are guaranteed.

Levels
Each stage is handcrafted and offers new traps and challenges. From city streets to rooftops and construction sites — every setting throws in fresh obstacles and reasons to laugh.

Multiplayer
Play together with friends either locally on one screen or online. Cooperation won’t be easy — sometimes your friend is the biggest trap of all.

Replayability
No two falls are ever the same. Even familiar levels turn into new stories full of randomness, fails, and fun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
